summary: Enhance your skills with Advanced Digital Records & Document Management course designed for Executive Assistants. Master efficient organization and retrieval.
lede: Digital records and document management helps executive assistants keep business information organized, secure, and retrievable throughout its lifecycle. For assistants and other professionals handling executive information, the practical work includes building filing structures, applying metadata and naming conventions, setting access permissions, and managing retention and disposal. The course also covers email records, approval workflows, and controlled use of cloud document platforms.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage executive information, maintain document order, and support secure records handling across daily workflows. Executive Assistants who manage board packs, correspondence, and approvals. Executive Secretaries responsible for filing discipline and controlled document routing. Administrative Officers who maintain shared drives and retrieval-ready records. Office Coordinators who standardise naming conventions and access permissions. Records Liaisons who apply retention and disposition rules to digital files. Document Control Assistants who track versions and approval status. Administrative Coordinators who organise email records and attachments. Executive Support Specialists who manage confidential information and archives. Operations Assistants who support workflow consistency across departments. Personal Assistants who need stronger digital filing and retrieval practices.
prerequisites: Participants should have basic office administration experience and working familiarity with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace. No coding or programming is required. A laptop is recommended for practical exercises, and access to a document repository, shared drive, or sample filing structure will help you complete the labs more effectively.
